description: Stormwater Network: Stormwater Weir is a dataset listed in Cary, NC Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Cary, NC Open Data. Coverage: Cary, North Carolina. The portal files it under Geographic Information System (GIS). Its keywords are stormwater. The portal shows 107 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-townofcary-org-portal.
